mapper.sql: wr.id, wr.account_id, wr.agent_id, wr.amount, wr.fee_rate, wr.fee_amount, wr.actual_amount, wr.bank_name, wr.bank_account, wr.bank_holder, wr.status, wr.remark, wr.create_time, wr.update_time, a.agent_name as agent_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM withdraw_records wr LEFT JOIN agents a ON wr.agent_id = a.id WHERE wr.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM withdraw_records wr LEFT JOIN agents a ON wr.agent_id = a.id WHERE wr.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY wr.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdraw_records (account_id, agent_id, amount, fee_rate, fee_amount, actual_amount, bank_name, bank_account, bank_holder, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{agentId}, #{amount}, #{feeRate}, #{feeAmount}, #{actualAmount}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{bankHolder}, #{status}, #{remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE withdraw_records SET account_id = #{accountId}, agent_id = #{agentId}, amount = #{amount}, fee_rate = #{feeRate}, fee_amount = #{feeAmount}, actual_amount = #{actualAmount}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_account = #{bankAccount}, bank_holder = #{bankHolder}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE withdraw_records SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
